exitCriteria: Replay a winning route for every advertised level. Close the remaining Oh No!, Xmas 1992, Holiday, L2, L3 and conversion gaps. Distinguish individual solutions from continuous campaign progression.
progress: Beta 23 reran all 6,395 indexed pre-L2 levels: 292 official Classic, 60 conversions and 6,043 fan levels. It reproduced 223 official Classic and 294 fan wins. Compared with the prior full-corpus audit, no winning routes were lost, no new load/render failures appeared, and eight more official routes won. The existing 94 fan load/start failures remain. 5,878 levels still lack verified winning replays, so the full-completion gate remains open. Input hashes did not drift. See Beta23Readiness.md and .build/beta23/classic-validation.

exitCriteria: Resolve provisional L3 tool, movement and trap semantics against original-engine evidence. Complete environmental effects, original movie audio and story transitions. Extend L2 original-engine comparisons.

Verify app and controller interruption on real hardware. Add versioned in-progress checkpoints and crash recovery before mobile suspend/termination support. Verify save migrations and rollback with real prior releases.
progress: Beta 24 passed both complete app journeys, including Classic/fan checkpoints, Hot Seat identity and paused handovers, replay journals, corruption, stale writers and safe solo transitions. Physical power-loss and installed-release migration trials remain open. See Beta24Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Test the complete first-launch-to-results flow with physical Xbox, PlayStation and Switch-layout controllers. Add remapping and device glyphs, touch targeting, readable UI scaling, reduced motion/flash controls and VoiceOver navigation without forcing OG gameplay.
progress: Beta 24 passed complete software-driven app journeys on Apple silicon and Intel/Rosetta, including keyboard/controller routing, held-F and mouse speed ramps, exact assignment eligibility, fonts, scalable menus, hints and interruption handling. Skill captions and green shortcut letters are restored; speed uses one continuous control. Physical controllers and full VoiceOver remain unverified. See Beta24Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Measure complete frame times, memory growth and audio under sustained 10x play, nukes, replays and repeated engine switches. Test physical Intel, minimum supported macOS, SDR/HDR, multiple displays and high refresh rates.
Freeze the final source and assets. Build both Mac architectures, sign, notarise and verify the downloaded archive. Earlier beta notarisation is not evidence for later local builds.
progress: Beta 24 ships from frozen inputs as a universal Mac app. Both complete app journeys passed (30 checks each; Intel under Rosetta), and all 25 core/resource suites passed. The standard archive is signed, notarised, stapled and accepted by Gatekeeper after extraction and quarantine. The separate Game Center archive is development signed for two registered Macs. Both contain matching cumulative notes since beta 18. See Beta24Readiness.md.

exitCriteria: Agree the proposed official product scope, brand use and asset distribution with the rights holder. Record code and asset provenance, third-party dependencies and approved distribution inputs. Obtain the required platform publishing access.
Validate first-play onboarding with novice players. Extend verified tiered hints beyond the original 120 levels and show supported mechanics clearly in imported packs.

Build and test the shared library with the iOS SDK. Implement a UIKit/Metal app shell, precise touch selection, safe-area layouts, audio/session interruptions, checkpoints, thermal budgets and device tests. A Package.swift deployment declaration is not an iOS app.

Use approved SDKs and hardware to establish the supported runtime and engine boundary. Implement native rendering, input, save/user services and suspend/resume adapters. Pass each platform's current requirements. Mac controller support is not a console port.

Validate Game Center on provisioned builds, network loss and offline records. Externalise product strings and verify layouts with translated text. Define platform account and cloud-save conflict handling.

Deliver an approved, reproducible demonstration build with a short feature tour, current evidence matrix, known limits, asset provenance and a platform delivery plan. Keep demonstration claims within verified scope.
